answer_1.quote: This paper aims to explore this hypothesis, focusing on the evaluation of automatic image description systems. ... We focus on image descriptions because it is relatively easy for humans to judge whether a given description correctly describes an image.

answer_4.quote: We used network sampling to recruit 61 volunteers ... In each trial, participants rated the quality of the erroneous description on a continuous scale from 0 (worst) to 100 (best), using a slider ... Each participant was asked to rate the quality of all 28 stimuli.
answer_4.guideline: Rate the quality of the erroneous description on a continuous slider from 0 (worst) to 100 (best) after viewing the image and reference description.
